rationale: The source passes the four-question gate. It is reusable: it explains the two consumer wiring steps, the exact-version peer pin and the silent failures each one prevents. It is citable at eval/navigation/heldout/corpus/packages__maplibre__README.md (79de8a1). It does not duplicate an existing page: map-atlas-engine only mentions the stylesheet and worker steps in passing, and no page covers @mapatlas/maplibre. A new contributor wiring the renderer, or debugging a map that never paints, needs it. This patch creates a concept page for the package, the counterpart of mapatlas-core-package. It also updates map-data-licensing with the renderer's licence obligation, harness-neutral-specs-contract with the rule that unchecked features are described only in prose, and map-atlas-engine with a source and a link. It adds an index entry and a log entry.

edits.rationale: No existing page covers the renderer package. This page records the exact-version peer pin, the single-MapLibre-instance reason, the worker and stylesheet failure modes, the focus-ring property and the mount API.
The renderer README restates the licensing obligation from the renderer's side. This edit adds that framing, the new source, the README section pointer and a link to the new page.

The renderer README adds a documentation rule to the contract: a block no gate checks is described in prose and is not presented as something to paste. This edit also records the renderer's compiled example files.
The engine page already summarizes the two wiring steps. This edit cites the renderer README as a source and links to the new renderer page, which holds the details.
Makes the new page reachable from index.md.
Records the ingest in the append-only log.
